title: Final Frequencies
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the normal-mode frequencies as omega_1 = 0, omega_2 = sqrt(k/m), and omega_3 = sqrt(3k/m).

title: First Mode Description
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately describe the first normal mode where x_1 = x_2 = x_3 = at + b.

title: Second Mode Description
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide the correct expressions for the second normal mode: x_1 = A cos(omega_2 t + phi), x_2 = 0, x_3 = -A cos(omega_2 t + phi).

title: Third Mode Description
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly express the third normal mode as x_1 = A cos(omega_3 t + phi), x_2 = -2A cos(omega_3 t + phi), x_3 = A cos(omega_3 t + phi).

title: Matrix Equation Setup
description: Optional Criteria: The student should set up the matrix equation correctly from the equations of motion derived from the Lagrangian.

title: Secular Equation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should derive the secular equation correctly from the matrix setup.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the equations of motion or incorrect expressions for the normal modes.
